Tether by Spacie — attended remote terminal debugging for developers and AI agents.

This draft contains Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, and Linux x64 installers, plus SHA-256 checksums. Every artifact is built from this tag after the shared cross-platform checks pass and its native MCP executable is tested.

These builds are unsigned development artifacts. Spacie must configure signing/notarization and complete native desktop testing before treating a release as a trusted customer distribution. Publishing this draft is a separate maintainer action.
